scope: Bounded read-only exact-source review of proposed IS2 diagnostic record/volatile DIC config runtime, GPIO sample age and cold/IRQ/flash boundaries

resolved_findings.resolution: UINT32 modular elapsed saturates at65535; cold data requires actual sample tuple; observing stale clears valid latch until a fresh actual sample, preventing later full-counter wrap revival. Both target DIC and DO use the same helper.

reviewed_constraints: CONFIG frame/CRC/opcode/shape/epoch/sequence validation precedes all commit state; rejected transactions do not alter config/epoch/sequence/accepted timestamp.
IRQ copies generation/group values atomically, samples actual GPIO and evolves debounce outside IRQ exclusion, then commits raw/filtered/time tuple only on the same generation.
CONFIG generation reset restarts debounce timing; no output/ARM/ACTIVE writer is added.
TIM2 accepted timestamp/state timeout tuple is protected from IRQ preemption; stale framing cannot refresh IWDG.
IWDG starts before factory flash inspection; startup/clock/option/reset timing remains physically unqualified.
Application flash is bounded to60KiB, records reserve two separate2KiB pages; target reads actual12-byte UID and never erase/programs flash.
UID+CRC+commit integrity cannot authenticate factory state; descriptor/hw_major remain diagnostic.
IDENT proposal preserves40-byte frame and first16 realtime bytes while borrowing only telemetry8 for512-byte chunks. Existing diagnostic major0 acquisition rejects unsupported record majors.
Two distinct valid generations require equal lineage; invalid/torn record fallback and equal-generation conflict are conservative.
additional_constraints: Sample validity is committed atomically with raw/filtered/last time under the same-generation guard; no config ISR can publish a mixed sample tuple.
The stale latch only affects sample availability; FIELD rail-good remains an independent hardware observation and no ACTIVE/ARM/output authority is added.
Host/target record formats remain explicitly proposed and unadopted; target does not authenticate Ed25519 or provision flash option bytes.
Default_Handler may reset-loop under corrupt ECC after software IWDG begins; recovery/clock/bootstrap reset behavior remains physically unqualified.
